title: onopordum corymbosum var. humile
intro: Onopordum corymbosum var. humile, commonly known as Dwarf Cotton Thistle, is a type of plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate conditions like arthritis and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce inflammation, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and provide wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Onopordum corymbosum var. humile include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
